title: Galon Siapa?
subject: six tenants of a kost in Jatinangor holding a midnight 'trial' in the hallway over who drank the last glass from the water galon and did not buy a new one, until they find the landlady's cat drinking from the drip tray
caption: Indonesian garage rock, 60s-style raw garage revival. Fuzzy overdriven electric guitar with three-chord bashing riffs, Farfisa-style combo organ playing stabbing high chords, driving eighth-note bass, loose crashing drums with tambourine on every beat. Raw trashy live-room recording, slightly blown-out and loud. Rough energetic male lead vocal with shouted gang backing on the hook, clearly sung melody. 152 BPM, E major. Mood of a noisy boarding-house hallway riot. No pop-punk gloss, no metal screams, no autotune, no synths, no rap.
lyrics:
[Intro - fuzz guitar riff, organ stab, drum count-in]
[Verse 1]
Jam dua belas malam di kos
Aku haus, gelas sudah di tangan
Kran galon kutekan, cuma angin
Satu tetes pun nggak keluar
[Pre-Chorus]
Pintu kamar kugedor satu-satu
Bangun semua, sidang dimulai!
[Chorus]
Galon siapa? Siapa yang habiskan?
Jadwal di kulkas bilang giliran Bayu
Galon siapa? Nggak ada yang ngaku
Enam orang haus, mulut kering semua
[Verse 2]
Bayu sumpah dia cuma minum teh
Dika bilang airnya buat masak mi
Fajar diam, mukanya pucat
Ternyata cuma ngantuk berat
[Bridge - organ solo, drums break down]
Lalu dari bawah dispenser
Kucing Bu Kos menjilat tetesan
[Chorus]
Galon siapa? Kucing yang habiskan!
Ekornya basah, matanya polos
Galon siapa? Besok patungan
Enam orang turun beli galon baru
[Outro - riff speeds up, final crash]
Meong!
Galon siapa?
